item.description:
PromptWars x Sphoorthy Engineering College

PromptWars is a virtual AI-focused hackathon designed to challenge participants to turn ideas into practical solutions using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and effective prompting.

Organized in collaboration with Sphoorthy Engineering College and powered by Hack2Skill, the initiative provides participants with an opportunity to explore AI technologies, solve real-world problem statements, experiment with innovative ideas, and showcase their technical creativity.

What to Expect

  • 🤖 AI and Generative AI-focused challenges
  • 💡 Real-world problem statements
  • 🧠 Prompt engineering and creative problem solving
  • 🚀 Hands-on solution building
  • 🏆 Competitive evaluation and recognition
  • 🌐 Fully virtual participation

Participants will compete individually and develop their solutions within the announced hackathon timeline. Each challenge will provide a specific problem statement and participants are encouraged to build practical, innovative, and impactful solutions.

Who Can Participate?

The hackathon is open to students, aspiring developers, AI enthusiasts, and builders interested in Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, prompt engineering, and emerging technologies.

Build. Experiment. Compete.

Bring your ideas, sharpen your prompting skills, and build solutions that demonstrate how AI can be applied to meaningful problems.

Get ready for PromptWars x Sphoorthy Engineering College — where ideas meet AI.

Build an AI-powered solution that can identify and assess digital scams such as phishing messages, fraudulent websites, fake offers, suspicious emails, and social-engineering attempts. The solution should explain why content appears risky and help users make safer decisions through clear, actionable guidance.
item.title: AI Scam Shield: Detect, Explain & Prevent Digital Scams
